correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 and labelled cycle C_n, a total outer-independent dominating set has exactly a cyclic distance-three packing as its complement: outside independence forbids adjacent outside vertices, and total domination forbids an outside pair at cyclic distance two. For three nonempty blocks the coalition graph without isolated vertices is P3 or K3. In a path, exactly the two leaf blocks are packing complements; in a triangle, all three are. Seven pair-color states, their 7x7 transition T with characteristic (x^3+x-1)(x^4-x^3-x^2-2x-1), and a weighted 3x3 forbidden-union U with polynomial x^3-x^2-2 give t_n-f_n. Paths are counted twice and unique three-periodic triangles (only 3|n) six times, hence N_n=(t_n-f_n)/2-2*[3|n]. T is primitive; the quartic Perron root dominates all other roots and U, giving N_n~lambda^n/2 with lambda=2.065994892... . Direct independent enumeration by original domination/neighborhood definitions confirmed unordered partitions for n=3..9: (1,6,10,25,63,130,280) with triangle at n=3,6,9, not extrapolation.
